title: Titrations and Molar Concentrations

problems_fixed.what: duplicate solution 0.25 (three silver problems shared it); changed Ca(OH)2 concentration 0.1->0.15 mol/dm3 so the answer becomes 0.375 mol/dm3, and rewrote both misconception messages to the new numbers
duplicate solution 0.25; changed H2SO4 titre 25.0->12.5 cm3 so the answer becomes 0.5 mol/dm3, and rewrote both misconception messages

expects_added: Added an 'expect' value to every misconception (validator now requires the key). Determinate slips were committed by hand (unit x1000/x100, inverse, ignored or inverted mole ratio, forgot flask scale-up, forgot cm3->dm3); indeterminate ones (wrong_Mr, full-solution forgot_step, and the 1:1 forgot_convert whose x1000 slips cancel) set to null so they never mis-fire.
figures_note: Pure-formula chemistry lesson (no circuits, no 'the graph shows' problems), so no SVG or chart figures were warranted per the diagram spec.
opener_concept: Orange squash: 6 spoons of powder in 2 litres vs 3 litres. The student finds 'spoons per litre' by common sense (6/2, 6/3), then the reveal names it as concentration = moles / volume.
guided_added: tier_guides (bronze/silver/gold with stepped examples), guided.opener, guided.teach walks (bronze 5 boxes, silver 6, gold 7), and guided_steps on all 20 bank problems. Every walk follows the science ritual: state equation, convert cm3->dm3 as its own box, substitute, compute, then a reversal check whose done-note states the answer with its unit. Completion boundary (phase:substitute) is placed so the set-up (conversions, moles-of-known, Mr) is pre-worked and the student does the ratio/final division/check.
other_edits: method_card.content slimmed to under the 140-word budget and its em dash removed.
exam_context.frequency em dash replaced with a colon.
worked_examples step labels: em dashes replaced with colons (validator bans em dashes anywhere student-facing).
Added a plain-text 'hint' to every problem (gold had none); kept every existing equation_hint byte-for-byte.
notes: Fresh-solved all 20 problems: every stored answer was already correct; only the two silver duplicate answers needed a numeric change. Verified independently that every guided box computes, every walk lands on the stored solution, and every non-null expect sits outside the accept window. Board-neutral throughout (no board names, no equation-sheet claims). all_row_ids contains only the canonical row; patched and confirmed byte-identical. Tier ladder matches the science spec (Bronze one formula, Silver one-pass titration+ratio, Gold multi-step flask scaling).
